subject.title: [Feature]: make agent aware of communication channel

question: Should this issue be scoped to command prompt metadata parity only, with channel-selective reply routing split into a separate API or policy follow-up?
rationale: The code gap is narrow and source-confirmed, but letting prompts choose delivery channels would change channel routing semantics and plugin/channel contracts.

options.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
options.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance only in command prompt reconstruction.

options.title: Split Selective Routing Design
options.body: Keep or create a separate maintainer-owned design item for channel-selective replies and the delivery-policy contract.

options.title: Declare Model-Selected Routing Out Of Scope
options.body: Close or document the selective-routing part as not planned while preserving deterministic host-controlled reply routing.

recommendation.title: Scope To Prompt Metadata Parity
recommendation.body: Implement normalized channel, account-aware capabilities, shell, host/OS/arch, and channel action/message guidance only in command prompt reconstruction.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue history and command-prompt provenance make this the clearest owner for deciding prompt metadata scope versus delivery-policy scope.
